description: A localeMatchSupplier handing the library a LocaleMatchResult built through its PUBLIC constructor. The supplier is invoked lazily at lookup time, so the constructor's refusal surfaces as a per-case throw rather than as an unbuildable fixture. Caller-supplied match results are revalidated on every use, so each of these is a live validation path a port must reproduce rather than a Java-only assertion. An UNMATCHED result (no selected locale) that nevertheless carries a language range.
